summary: Build advanced complaint handling, recovery scripts, and escalation skills. Learn through practical case work and reporting tools.
lede: Service recovery and complaint handling gives customer-facing professionals a structured way to resolve complaints and service failures. It covers complaint classification, root-cause investigation, de-escalation, recovery decisions, and CRM case tracking, helping participants plan corrective actions and monitor measures such as turnaround time, first-contact resolution, and recurrence. The practical focus is on handling cases consistently, documenting promises and outcomes, and closing the loop with customers and internal teams.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who handle complaints, oversee service recovery, or manage customer-facing operations where failed service moments must be resolved quickly and consistently.
prerequisites: Participants should have working experience in customer service, complaints, service operations, contact center management, or customer experience roles. No coding is required, but you should be comfortable reading complaint logs, escalation reports, and KPI dashboards, and be prepared to work with case-based exercises, service recovery scripts, and CRM-style workflows.
